scope: Q9-only internal integer representation pilot; no complete-suite score
mechanism: Initial six-key candidate was rejected by the existing shared-broadcast guard before timing. B2 narrows only the three supplier keys; part keys remain BIGINT. Control creates BIGINT views. Full retained Q9 results checked for timed actions. Output and decimal arithmetic are unchanged.
domain: Every row group of all 1024 input files has signed int32 key extrema; file set, sizes and mtimes are checked before both benchmark arms. Immutable-input assumption remains.
decision: Do not select the SQL-cast prototype. B1 loses part broadcast reuse; B2 restores reuse but changes join ordering. A physical representation change that preserves cost statistics is a distinct unmeasured follow-up, not disproved by these probes.
limits: Candidate key casts can change Catalyst statistics, join order and hash partition distribution as well as shuffle width; inspect retained plans before attribution
No page-cache flush; physical I/O is recorded for every query
Native KvikIO fixed at 32 threads; no native preload or early-shuffle companion
This is a proof-gated experiment, not an automatic production narrowing rule
cleanup_authorization: Terminate only instances created by this session after useful investigation and evidence preservation
